title: RAW_UNSCREENED: ol-Kerne erhalten Inhalt über zusammengesetzte Formen
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: ol, olkain, olshey, olshedy und ololchey könnten eine relationale Schicht vor wiederverwendeten Inhaltskernen bilden; dies prüft keine allgemeine ol-Grammatik und bestätigt keine Stoffbedeutung.

design.scope_description: Only the exposed f80v.30-.37, f77r.9-.24 and f85r1.4-.5 cases in the Luna packet, preserving all reader boundaries.
design.mechanism: A written ol layer modifies a retained kernel (kain, shey, shedy, ky, keedy), so related ol compounds share a content head while bare ol supplies the relation locally.
design.unit: Exact ol-family forms and immediate safe neighbors: f80v.30 olkain; .31 ol/olkain/olshey; .32 olky/qolkain; .33 olkain/olshedy; .34 olshey/olkain; .36 olshedy olal shedy; f85r1.4-.5 olshedy/olkeedy.
design.contrast: Kernel-preserving composition versus every ol-family form being an unrelated whole word.
design.prediction: Kernel-preserving composition predicts repeated kernels and neighbor classes across at least f80v and f85r1, while unrelated wholes predict no excess shared kernel once paragraph and reader are held fixed.
design.shared_mechanism: ol is a relational prefix/shell and the remainder supplies the recurring content head; no English value is assigned to either part.
concrete_observations: f80v.30-.36 contains a dense run of olkain, olshey, olshedy, olky, qolkain and bare ol.
f85r1.4 has olshedy qokeedy and .5 has olkeedy ... olshedy, while f77r.23 has olshedy qokeedy in a different paragraph.
linked_consequences: A retained kernel should recur with comparable neighboring content classes even when the ol shell changes.
The same kernel-based grouping should explain why olshedy appears beside qokeedy at f77r.23 and f85r1.4 without importing a liquid or portion gloss.
design.nearest_rival: Each ol-form is an independent lexical item, with apparent shared letters carrying no compositional content.
design.distinguishing_observation: Use a predeclared exact-kernel inventory and compare cross-paragraph neighbor overlap to a form-length/position matched null; a compositional signal requires both a shared kernel and a repeated neighbor class, not merely the letters ol.
design.strongest_likely_failure: The f80v cluster is a paragraph-specific register and the few cross-paragraph pairs do not preserve neighbors; GDT945/GDT946 already show that narrow olal role contracts fail known side positions.
